correctness.rationale: The every-independent-set admissibility argument is valid for all symmetric attack graphs; on forests, the isolated-unmarked-neighbour lemma has a complete constructive converse using forbidden 3-, 4- and 5-cycles. The path automaton is exact by five-local windows with virtual boundary bits. The 16-entry identity (T^5-T^4-T^3+T-I)B=0 and first seven counts prove the rational series for every length; a standard-library checker independently verified it plus all 9987 loop-marked labelled forests of orders at most five. Finite cases corroborate rather than replace the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Self-attacks are the precise obstruction omitted by classical symmetric-coherence criteria. The result gives a local if-and-only-if decision test in arbitrary finite forests, then a complete nontrivial exact marking spectrum on paths with a fifth-order recurrence and exponentially vanishing robust fraction. These answer a natural structural and quantitative question at the border of preferred/stable agreement; neither follows simply from existing maximal-independent-set nomenclature.
